Assessment of BA.evidence_source: We conducted exploratory factor analyses of the BAS data for the migrant and non-migrant groups separately. Among the migrant sample, ten of the BAS items loaded onto a General Body Appreciation factor (factor loadings ≥ .43; α = .88); among the non-migrant sample, 10 items loaded onto a General Body Appreciation factor (factor loadings ≥ .45; α = .90).

section_summary.extract_value: This section reports exploratory factor analyses of BAS items conducted separately for migrant and non-migrant samples, finding two factors in each sample but retaining only an overall General Body Appreciation score due to problems with the second factor. Ten BAS items loaded on a General Body Appreciation factor in both samples (α = .88 and .90), and the non-migrant sample showed significantly higher general body appreciation than the migrant sample. The section explicitly describes two subsamples (migrant vs. non-migrant) rather than multiple numbered studies.
